pages.text: The Voodoo Poppet is probably the most interesting poppet in this book. It allows its creator to influence another player in multiple different ways. $(br)In order for this to work you will need to combine a normal poppet with leads, spider eyes and an enderpearl. If done correctly this will make it possible to create a strong binding to another player.
Once a binding is established this will make it possible to inflict harm on the bound player and even to fling them around.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: A bound Voodoo Poppet has four abilities:$(li)Needle: hold a needle offhand, charge for one second, then release to deal 2 damage.$(li)Push: do the same without a needle to fling the target.$(li)Water: drop it underwater to drain the target's air.$(li)Fire: drop it into fire to burn the target.

The poppet has 20 durability. Successful needle hits cost one point and consume a needle. Pushing costs two points. Fire and successful drowning hits cost two points.$(br2)The bound player must be online. $(l:poppets/voodoo_protection_poppet)Voodoo Protection$(/l) destroys the attacking poppet when it activates.
